+        if parsed.tzinfo is None:

+        return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)

+def _infer_trend(values: List[float]) -> str:
+    if len(values) < 2:
+        return "insufficient-data"
+    first = values[0]
+    last = values[-1]
+    if last > first * 1.05:
+        return "increasing"
+    if last < first * 0.95:
+        return "decreasing"
+    return "stable"
